community_rule: Community and video sources are discovery leads only until independently supported.
market_rule: A meteorological forecasting improvement without executable market mispricing is not a trading edge.
promotion_rule: No candidate may be called proven unless every required gate passes out of sample.
weather_rule: Predict TWC settlement value as black box; do not equate objective weather truth with settlement.
recon_rule: Recon may aggressively investigate free/public/passive evidence of economic leaks, failures, successes, behavioral weakness, informed-flow signatures and unintended market mechanisms. Discovery is not proof; serious candidates must be routed through falsification and execution-realism gates.
recon_execution_boundary: Strategic/manipulation mechanisms may be studied as intelligence, but unauthorized access, credential abuse, fraud/deception, acquisition of stolen/private/non-public information, active security exploitation and prohibited or illegal execution are not permitted. Retain such mechanisms only as NON_EXECUTABLE intelligence when useful.
